comingLast.roast: on 20 - his last realistic saviour just signed for more, ouch
finished 2 clear of the blue balls - now buying Hewitt drinks out of gratitude
in on a cushion of 3 - refreshing the board between sips
finished 4 above Hewitt - close enough to keep his speech drafted
done and dangling 4 above the blue balls - do not jinx it
safe-ish by 4 - the blue balls have come back from further
in on 4 above the drop - his shout if he survives, tradition says
finished with a 5-point buffer - his group is still reminding him hourly
safe by 5 unless the course gets generous late
